title: 第5 章 修行第6 章 您今年高寿
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 不知过了多久，【道行】后的数字缓缓跳动到“伍”，随即便仿佛触及了某个上限，停滞不动，不再增长。
沈回心中了然，心想这或许便是当前阶段的积累极限。或者说，是这“金手指”单次“蓄能”的容量。
他不再等待，缓缓退出定境。
眼帘将启未启之时，他忽觉面前光线似乎被什么挡住，一股温热的气息几乎喷到脸上。
沈回下意识睁眼，一张有些婴儿肥的脸蛋几乎贴到了他的鼻尖。
乌溜溜的眼珠里满是好奇，距离近得他能看清对方纤长的睫毛。
沈回吓了一大跳，本能一个战术后仰，脊背结结实实地撞到了身后墙壁。
他定睛一看，这才发现面前是四师姐静慧。
此刻她正前倾着身子，一眨不眨地盯着他瞧。
而在她身后，大师兄李长兴、二师姐静明、三师兄清逸、五师兄清石，竟全都围在房中，或站或坐，目光齐刷刷地落在他身上，脸上俱是惊奇。
沈回一时愕然，有种当众拉屎被人围观的错觉，脸色不禁有些尴尬。
“哎呀！醒了醒了！”
静慧第一个叫起来，猛地直起身，拍着手，脸上兴奋更甚，“清玄师弟，你可真能坐！从晌午到现在，足足五个时辰，一动也不动！”
“五个时辰？”沈回自己也是一惊。
他转头望向窗外，这才注意到，窗纸外透入的天光已是昏黄一片，染着淡淡的暮色。
他竟然入定了这么长时间？
还没来得及细想，众人已七嘴八舌地议论开来。
“何止是能坐！”
三师兄清逸摇着头，脸上带着些许惊叹，“寻常弟子初次入定，能坚持一盏茶功夫已是难得，一炷香便是天赋异禀。师弟你……五个时辰，纹丝不动，呼吸几近于无，这哪里是天赋异禀，简直是……”
“简直是百年一遇的奇才！”五师兄清石连忙接话，眼里满是佩服。
“哪里哪里……”沈回连忙摆手，心说不就是入定么，那不跟按f键上车一样简单，他怎么着也算是千年一遇的奇才啊。
“师弟无需过谦，”二师姐静明看向沈回的目光也多了几分深意，“初入定便能如此深、如此久，且周身气数隐有浑然天成之感，毫无初学者的滞涩虚浮……此等心性资质，确是命理玄奇。”
“对对对！命理玄奇！”
静慧小鸡啄米似的点头，一双大眼睛在沈回脸上扫来扫去，仿佛想找出“奇”在何处。
各种溢美之词劈头盖脸砸来，沈回有些招架不住，脸上发热，连忙摆手：“师兄师姐过誉了，过誉了！师弟不过是……”
可随即他又觉得任何解释都有些徒劳，于是便赶紧转移话题，看向静明，问出了心中的疑惑：“二师姐，您方才说我‘命理玄奇’……这话却是从何说起？”
他隐约觉得，这或许与自己穿越者的身份，或者那古怪的“界面”有关。
静明看了他一眼，略作沉吟，“我随师父学过些望气相面之术。从你面相十二宫、气色流转来看，本应是……福薄缘浅之人，眉宇间隐有黑气纠缠，主早年孤苦，运势蹇涩，且有……”
她顿了顿，似乎斟酌了一下用词，“且有短促横夭之相。”
沈回心中猛地一跳。
短促横夭之相，说白了就是短命相。他穿越前，可不就是“横夭”么？
但静明话锋一转，眼中又露出些许困惑：“然而古怪之处在于，此等凶相之下，却有一线隐晦紫气潜藏，似枯木逢春，绝处逢生。更兼如今你神完气足，眸光清正，那预示凶兆的气色已淡去大半，反倒透出几分……难以测度的变数。此等矛盾纠结，否极泰来之相，岂非‘奇’？岂非‘玄’？”
沈回默然。
他能说什么？说二师姐你看得真准，我确实死过一次，但又从另一个世界爬过来了？
content_en:
After an unknown amount of time, the number after [Dao Xing] slowly jumped to "five", and then it seemed to have hit a certain upper limit, stagnating and no longer growing.
Shen Hui understood clearly and thought that this might be the accumulation limit at this stage. In other words, it is the single "energy storage" capacity of this "gold finger".
He no longer waited and slowly exited the tranquil state.
When his eyes were about to open, he suddenly felt that the light in front of him seemed to be blocked by something, and a warm breath almost hit his face.
Shen Hui subconsciously opened his eyes, and a baby-fat face almost touched the tip of his nose.
His dark eyes were full of curiosity, and he was so close that he could clearly see the other person's long eyelashes.
"Ho--!"
Shen Hui was startled. He instinctively leaned back and his back hit the wall behind him.
He took a closer look and realized that in front of him was Fourth Senior Sister Jinghui.
She was leaning forward now, staring at him without blinking.
Behind her, Senior Brother Li Changxing, Second Senior Sister Jingming, Third Senior Brother Qingyi, and Fifth Senior Brother Qingshi were all surrounding the room, standing or sitting, all looking at him with surprise on their faces.
Shen Hui was stunned for a moment, having the illusion that he was defecating in public and being watched, and his face couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed.
"Oops! Wake up, wake up!"
Jinghui was the first to cry out, straightened up suddenly, clapped her hands, her face even more excited, "Junior brother Qingxuan, you can really sit down! From noon to now, it has been five hours without moving at all!"
"Five hours?" Shen Hui himself was also surprised.
He turned to look out the window, and then he noticed that the skylight filtering through the window paper was already dim, dyed with a faint twilight.
He has been in trance for so long?
Before I had time to think about it, everyone was already talking about it.
"More than being able to sit!"
Third senior brother Qingyi shook his head, with a hint of amazement on his face, "For ordinary disciples who have entered samadhi for the first time, it is rare to be able to hold on to a cup of tea. A stick of incense is a gift. Junior brother, you...have been motionless for five hours, breathing almost nothing. This is not a gift, it is simply..."
"He is simply a once-in-a-century genius!" Fifth senior brother Qingshi quickly answered, his eyes full of admiration.
"Where, where..." Shen Hui waved his hands quickly, thinking that it was just entering samadhi. It was not as simple as pressing the F key to get in the car. No matter what, he could be regarded as a once-in-a-millennium genius.
"Junior brother, there is no need to be too modest," Second Senior Sister Jingming looked at Shen Hui with a more profound look, "You can be so deep and long in concentration for the first time, and the Qi in your whole body has a natural feeling, without the sluggishness and vainness of a beginner... Such mental qualifications are indeed mysterious in fortune telling."
"Yes, yes! Numerology is mysterious!"
Jinghui nodded like a chicken pecking at rice, and her big eyes scanned Shen Hui's face, as if trying to find out where the "strange" was.
All kinds of complimentary words were thrown at him, and Shen Hui couldn't resist it. His face became hot, and he waved his hands quickly: "Senior brother and sister are over-praising, over-praising! Junior brother is just..."
But then he felt that any explanation was somewhat futile, so he quickly changed the subject, looked at Jingming, and asked the doubts in his heart: "Second Senior Sister, you just said that I am 'mysterious fortune teller'... where did you start with this?"
He vaguely felt that this might be related to his identity as a time traveler, or the weird "interface".
Jingming glanced at him and pondered for a moment, "I have learned some fortune-telling techniques from my master. Judging from the twelve palaces of your face and the flow of your complexion, you should be...a person with poor fortune and shallow fortune. There is a dark energy entangled between the eyebrows. You were lonely in your early years and had a bad fortune, and you have..."
She paused and seemed to consider her choice of words, "It also has the appearance of being short and unlucky."
Shen Hui's heart jumped suddenly.
The short-lived phase is, to put it bluntly, the short-lived phase. Before he traveled through time, wasn't he "Hengyao"?
But Jingming changed the subject, and there was some confusion in his eyes: "However, the strange thing is that under such a fierce appearance, there is a faint line of purple energy lurking, like a dead tree springing up, a life coming out of a desperate situation. What's more, now that you are full of energy and your eyes are clear, the color that foreshadows ominousness has mostly faded, but there are some...unfathomable variables. Isn't it 'strange' that such contradictions and entanglements are a sign of peace and prosperity? Isn't it 'mysterious'?"
Shen returned to silence.
What could he say? Second Senior Sister, are you right? I did die once, but I crawled back from another world?
